items.period: Shang oracle-script style, as identified by the file description
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector drawing linked by the file page to Xiaoxuetang record 41.F2ED
items.caption: This modern vector drawing is identified as a Shang oracle-script-style form of 學. It shows a detached mark above crossing strokes, an angular middle, and a separate lower shape with two descending strokes. Its appearance alone does not establish component identities or settle the competing analyses of 學’s early construction.
items.alt: Black glyph on white: a detached mark above crossing strokes, an angular middle section, and a separate lower shape with two descending strokes.
items.selection_reason: The drawing offers a visual reference for discussing early 學 while keeping the construction uncertain. It is a modern tracing, not an excavated inscription specimen.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The drawing is a modern tracing rather than an excavated inscription specimen. Its archaeological date and context are unspecified, and the competing interpretations of 學’s early construction remain unresolved.
